name: collaborative-aidlc-kirocrew
description: Use Collaborative AI-DLC through the supported KiroCrew experience instead of deploying another custom UI.
author: Collaborative AI-DLC contributors
highlights: Selectable Kiro, Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode harness
Manual mixed-harness handoffs through the Remote Crew preview
File-native state, receipts, artifacts, and audit trail
configuration: Install and enable this app from the KiroCrew App Store local-install flow.
Select the collaborative-aidlc-conductor agent for the intent chat.
Choose an installed agent harness under Settings → Developer → Agent Backend.

commands.title: Start Collaborative AI-DLC intent
commands.subtitle: Run an AI-DLC intent in this repository using KiroCrew

argument.hint: Include users, desired outcome, constraints, and out-of-scope items.

commands.prompt: Run only if this chat uses the collaborative-aidlc-conductor agent. Otherwise ask me to select that agent and stop. Then load the collaborative-aidlc-kirocrew skill and start a governed Collaborative AI-DLC intent for: {argument}
